products.name: Masters of the Universe Origins Man-E-Faces figure 14cm
products.description: Masters of the Universe. Approximate figure size: 14cm. Articulated figure. This MOTU toy has the classic look of Man-E-Faces, but with modern styling in 14cm scale and 16 points of articulation so he can strike battle poses. This figure is inspired by the episode The Mystery of Man-E-Faces, the character's origin story. His rotating faces allow for endless storytelling. Turn... He's human. Turn again... He is a robot. Spin again... He's a monster! The removable body parts and removable helmet/harness of the multi-faced heroic warrior offer various possibilities to combine with other MOTU Origins figures.

products.name: Masters of the Universe Origins Tri-Klops figure 14cm
products.description: Masters of the Universe. Approximate figure size: 14cm. Articulated figure. This MOTU toy is a modern model of the classic look of the all-seeing character in 14cm scale and with 16 points of articulation so he can strike battle poses. Tri-Klops' visor swivels and clicks into place to reveal his 3 eyes. His rock-smoothing tool accessory is inspired by the episode The Royal Cousin. The evil warrior's removable body parts and harness offer several possibilities for combining with other MOTU Origins figures. Fans will want to collect all the figures in the Cartoon Collection to form a nostalgic display that will remind them of their wonderful 80's childhood.

products.name: Masters of the Universe Turtles of Grayskull Mekanek figure 14cm
products.description: Masters of the Universe. Approximate figure size: 14cm. Articulated figure. This Turtles of Grayskull action figure of Mekaneck from MOTU Origins depicts the exciting union of the Ninja Turtles and Masters of the Universe worlds as they clash in the Reptile Wars. The Ninja Turtles scour Eternia in search of Shredder, only to find themselves caught up in King Hiss' plot to turn the Snake Men into the most powerful force in the universe. This 14cm scale Grayskull Venom Defence Mekaneck figure has 16 movable joints for impressive battle poses and action moves from the Reptilian War. Mekaneck features 2 neck extenders, a removable torso armour piece and a poison shield. He is armed with his signature club. The included mini-comic illustrates the history of the Reptilian War, which can encourage creative play and expose the two worlds!

products.name: Masters of the Universe Origins Hordak figure 14cm
products.description: Masters of the Universe. Approximate figure size: 14cm. Articulated figure. This Hordak figure from the Masters of the Universe Origins Cartoon Collection celebrates the 40th anniversary of She-Ra: Princess of Power and will bring back fond memories of the 1980s TV series with its true-to-content look. This MOTU Origins toy is a modern model of the classic look of the Horror Horde leader in 14cm scale and with 16 points of articulation so he can strike battle poses. Hordak's appearance and time-stopping accessory are inspired by the Princess of Power episode Loo-Kee Lends Aid. The Etheria baddie's removable body parts and harness offer several possibilities for combining with other MOTU Origins figures.

products.name: Batman Forever Movie Masterpiece Action Figure 1/6 Robin 30 cm
products.description:
"R? What's that stand for?" - Batman

Like Bruce Wayne, young Dick Grayson witnessed the murder of his parents and swore to dedicate himself to bringing the criminals to justice. Under the strong wing of Batman, Dick managed to set aside his bitterness and thirst for revenge, turning them into a passion for righting wrongs, battling evil, and eventually becoming Batman's trusted crime-fighting partner, Robin. When one of them is in danger, the other is sure to help find a way out of it!

Inspired by the movie Batman Forever, Sideshow and Hot Toys present the Robin Sixth Scale Collectible Figure.

The highly-accurate figure is specially crafted based on the image of Robin, featuring a newly developed head sculpt with stunning likeness perfectly translating the details including the face mask, a specialized body portraying his muscular body, detail recreation of Robin's iconic costume with an "R" logo with a subtle metallic shimmer, also a figure base for display.

The new figure is a must-have for fans of the Boy Wonder! Pre-order it today!

products.name: Laid-Back Camp Action Figure Chiaki Ogaki 10 cm
products.description:
"Welcome to the Outdoor Activities Club!"

From the anime series "Laid-Back Camp" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of the Outdoor Activities Club president Chiaki Ogaki! She comes with three face plates including her grinning expression, her blank expression and her notable goading expression from the show. A shouting face plate for use with Nendoroid Nadeshiko Kagamihara is also included, allowing you to recreate the scene from episode 9 when Chiaki kidnaps Nadeshiko! In addition to her standard twintails head part, a head part to display her wearing her hat is also included.

For optional parts, she comes with her skillet, meat, a paper fan, a handwritten sign and her smartphone. Additionally, a social media text plate to recreate the iconic timelines from the series and a paper craft cardboard box are included. Enjoy camping with all of the Outdoor Activities Club members! Be sure to add her to your collection!

The Nendoroid-style figure stands approx. 10 cm tall and comes with base and figure stand.

products.name: Star Wars: Episode VI 40th Anniversary Action Figure 1/6 Darth Vader 35 cm
products.description:
Forever scarred by his defeat on Mustafar, Darth Vader was transformed into a cybernetically enhanced Sith Lord. He remained in service of Emperor Palpatine for decades, enforcing his Master's will and seeking to crush the Rebel Alliance and other detractors.

Celebrating Star Wars: Return Of The Jedi 40th anniversary, Sideshow and Hot Toys are delighted to introduce a series of collectibles based on this iconic film for fans and presents the new Darth Vader Sixth Scale Figure!

The highly accurate Star Wars collectible features a meticulously crafted Darth Vader helmet with complex interior mechanical detail, a remarkable likeness of Anakin Skywalker, highly detailed armor and skillfully tailored body suit, LED light-up chest panel and belt, an LED light-up lightsaber, and a specially designed themed figure base!

This stunning Star Wars action figure will be an incredible part of your Star Wars: Return Of The Jedi collection!

products.name: Predator Movie Masterpiece Action Figure 1/6 Predator (2.0) Deluxe Version 34 cm
products.description:
"Those Eyes. They Just Disappeared." - Mac

Known for their advanced technology, stealth, and deadly skills, Predators are iconic extraterrestrial hunters that leave fans of all generations both terrified and captivated. Thriving on the thrill of the hunt, they expertly use camouflage and powerful weapons to track their prey. They first burst onto the scene in Predator (1987), where one cunningly stalks a group of elite soldiers, picking them off one by one in a heart-pounding game of survival.

Sideshow and Hot Toys is proud to present the new Predator Sixth Scale Figure (2.0) Collectible Figure (Deluxe Version), which perfectly captures the essence of the classic menacing alien creature.

Inspired by the movie Predator (1987), this screen-accurate action figure features a newly developed head sculpt with separate rolling eyeballs and multiple finely crafted rubber strands of hair. It also includes two sets of interchangeable mandibles and an LED-lighted Predator mask, offering fans multiple display options. Dressed in newly designed Predator armor with weathering effects, an overall net costume, and bone accessories, this figure recreates the iconic look of this fierce species from the movie.  The figure comes equipped with an impressive array of weapons, including an articulated shoulder cannon, blades, and a red-colored spine with a skull. 

The Deluxe Version features an exciting new jungle-themed diorama base, two skull accessories, as well as an intruguing additional battle-damaged Predator mask based on a concept art design from the early development phase that never appeared in the film. This allows for an even more dynamic and captivating display. 

Step into the hunt with this legendary extraterrestrial hunter. Secure your Predator figure today and elevate your collection to new heights!

products.name: Metroid Prime 3 Corruption Figma Action Figure Samus Aran Prime 3 Ver. 16 cm
products.description:
From the Nintendo Wii exclusive game "Metroid Prime 3: Corruption" comes a rerelease of the figma of the main character, Samus Aran!

- Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can act out a variety of different scenes.
- A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability.
- The figma includes a morph ball part as well as interchangeable parts for her arm cannon based on when she fires missiles.
- Alternate hand parts included a clenched fist, open hand, hand for holding items and the classic thumbs-up hand.
- The visor of her mask as well as the areas on her hands, hips and legs make use of translucent parts for improved detail.
- An articulated figma stand is included, which allows various poses to be taken.
